summary: Eren asks Ymir, who has obeyed for two thousand years, to choose. The walls answer by walking, and Zeke's quiet end has no listener left.

segments.ja: 父の記憶の次に、ユミルの時間が開きます。開く時間は、二千年です。二千年のあいだ、彼女は王家の命令を実行してきました。してきました。道と呼ばれる場所に、彼女は一人で立っています。立っている姿を、ジークはまだ機能として扱います。扱う機能に、エレンは人の名で声を向けます。向ける声は、命令ではありません。命令ではない声が、二千年の沈黙に触れます。
segments.en: After the father's memory, Ymir's time opens. The time that opens is two thousand years. For those two thousand years, she has carried out the royal family's orders. She has. In the place called the paths, she is standing alone. Zeke still treats the form that is standing as a function. Eren turns his voice toward the function he treats, by a person's name. The voice he turns is not an order. The voice that is not an order touches a silence of two thousand years.

segments.ja: エレンは、ユミルに選択を返します。返す選択は、誰かの王のためではなく、自分のためです。ための中身を、彼は世界への罰として持ちます。持つ罰は、壁が歩き、外の地を踏む、です。踏む未来を、彼女に見せます。見せる見せ方は、強制の手順ではありません。ではありません。二千年、選べなかった人に、選べと渡すことです。渡す手が、断罪の続きです。続きは、壁の一歩として地上へ出ます。
segments.en: Eren returns a choice to Ymir. The choice he returns is not for someone's king. It is for herself. He holds the inside of that for as a punishment of the world. The punishment he holds is that the walls walk and trample the lands outside. He shows her the future of trampling. The way of showing is not a procedure of force. It is not. It is handing, to a person who could not choose for two thousand years, the words that she may choose. The hand that hands it is a continuation of the judgment. The continuation goes out to the ground as one step of the walls.

It is the end that makes the walls walk. In front of the will that makes them walk, the father's regret becomes a small sound. Eren neither denies the small sound nor stops it. The choice of not stopping leaves the father's regret small.

After the listener of euthanasia disappeared from Ymir, only the key remains. The key that remained is used for the walk the younger brother chose. The older brother has no words that stop the being used. Without having them, he is inside the row. The row he is in is a different direction from the grass.

segments.titleEn: Gabi and Reiner see the horizon
segments.ja: 地上の端で、ガビとライナーが地平を見ます。見る地平は、壁だった線が動き出した線です。動き出した線を、ガビは自分の一発の結果として理解します。理解する重さは、マーレの正義より大きいです。大きい地平の前で、ライナーは鎧の記憶を小さく感じます。感じる小ささを、彼は言葉にしません。しない隣で、ガビは銃を下ろします。下ろす手が、今日の地上の最初の変化です。
segments.en: At the edge of the ground, Gabi and Reiner look at the horizon. The horizon they look at is a line that was a wall and has started to move. Gabi understands the line that started to move as the result of her own shot. The weight she understands is larger than Marley's justice. In front of the large horizon, Reiner feels the memory of the Armor as small. He does not put the smallness he feels into words. Beside the not putting, Gabi lowers the gun. The hand that lowers it is the first change on today's ground.

segments.titleEn: Two thousand years end the order
segments.ja: 二千年の命令は、この選択で役目を終えます。終える役目は、王家の言葉を待ち続けることでした。続けることをやめたユミルは、エレンの歩きに力を重ねます。重ねる力は、壁の巨人の一歩です。一歩を、世界はまだ名前で理解していません。理解していない地の向こうで、列はすでに出ています。出ている列を、弟は未来の記憶で父に見せた景色と同じにします。同じ景色が、今日、現在になります。現在になった列は、父に見せた景色のまま進みます。
segments.en: The order of two thousand years ends its role with this choice. The role that ends was to keep waiting for the royal family's words. Ymir, who stopped continuing that, lays her power over Eren's walk. The power she lays over it is one step of the giants of the walls. The world does not yet understand the step by a name. Beyond the lands that do not understand, the row is already out. The younger brother makes the row that is out the same as the scene he showed his father in the memory from ahead. The same scene becomes the present today. The row that became the present still advances in the scene shown to the father.

segments.ja: アルミンの声は、道の部屋には届きません。届かない声は、地上で友の名を呼んでいます。呼んでいる名は、海を見る約束の相手です。相手の意識は、ユミルと壁の答えにいます。いる答えを、正論は引き戻せません。戻せない机は、もう空です。空の地上で、彼はまだ会話を捨てていません。捨てていないことが、歩く列の外に残る人間の仕事です。仕事は、名を呼び続けることです。
segments.en: Armin's voice does not reach the room of the paths. The voice that does not reach is calling a friend's name on the ground. The name he is calling is the person of the promise to see the sea. The person's mind is with Ymir and the answer of the walls. A sound argument cannot pull back the answer that is there. The desk that cannot pull it back is already empty. On the empty ground, he has not yet discarded the conversation. The not discarding is the work of the humans who remain outside the walking row. The work is to keep calling the name.

segments.ja: この話の時間は、エレンからユミルへだけではありません。ではありません。二千年、命令を待っていた人から、今の世界へも向かっています。向かう選択が、壁の一歩です。一歩の責任を、エレンは自分で持ちます。持つ責任を、ジークは共有できません。共有できない兄は、列の中で遅れています。遅れている世界が、今日の終わりです。終わりは、静かな死ではありません。
segments.en: The time of this story is not only from Eren to Ymir. It is not. It also heads toward the world of now, from a person who waited for an order for two thousand years. The choice that heads there is one step of the walls. Eren holds the responsibility of the step himself. Zeke cannot share the responsibility he holds. The older brother who cannot share it is late inside the row. The world that is late is the end of today. The end is not a quiet death.

segments.ja: 今日の言葉です。二千年、ユミルは王家の命令を実行してきました。エレンは、従い続けなくていい、と人として言います。ジークの安楽死は、聞き手を失います。ユミルは、選択を受け、壁を歩かせます。フリーダが止め、ユミルが歩く、その差が今日です。ヒストリアは、島の地上にいます。ミカサは、壊れた体の方向を走ります。ガビは、地平を見て銃を下ろします。下ろした世界は、もう父の記憶ではありません。
segments.en: Today's words. For two thousand years, Ymir carried out the royal family's orders. Eren tells her, as a person, that she does not have to keep obeying. Zeke's euthanasia loses its listener. Ymir receives the choice and makes the walls walk. Frieda stopped, and Ymir walks. That difference is today. Historia is on the ground of the island. Mikasa runs toward the broken body. Gabi looks at the horizon and lowers the gun. The world where she lowered it is no longer the father's memory.

The continuation goes out to the ground as one step of the walls.
